project_scope.note: Approved B008 Central Texas sumac set. Rhus copallinum var. lanceolata retains Rhus lanceolata as a prominent synonym. Rhus trilobata is treated within current Rhus aromatica.

shared_traits: woody shrubs or small trees with alternate compound leaves
resinous/aromatic tissues common in the family
fruit and leaf architecture are more useful than flower color
priority: distinguish three-leaflet Rhus aromatica from Toxicodendron radicans
study_strategy.warning: Do not teach 'leaves of three = poison ivy.' Rhus aromatica also has three leaflets. Do not use sap contact or crushing as an identification test.

quick_key.if: many narrow leaflets + conspicuously winged rachis + deciduous small tree/shrub
5–9 thick glossy entire leaflets + evergreen/semi-evergreen shrub
exactly 3 often lobed/coarsely toothed leaflets + low deciduous suckering shrub

b066_study_strategy.warning: Current Kew treats R. trilobata as a synonym of R. aromatica var. aromatica. Do not maintain duplicate species/variety learners.

quick_split: R. aromatica — exactly 3 larger fan-shaped/lobed leaflets; low suckering shrub; local PASS.
R. microphylla — several much smaller leaflets on a pinnate leaf; dry western/southwestern shrub; range HOLD.
